title: Hard Negatives or False Negatives: Correcting Pooling Bias in Training Neural Ranking Models

bias_targets.methodology: Formulating the false negative issue in training Neural Ranking Models (NRMs) as a biased dataset problem and evaluating it by jointly learning a relevance model and a selection model using a Coupled Estimation Technique (CET) based on an inverse propensity weighting (IPW) framework.
